name: Worgen in the Woods
summary: In Worgen in the Woods, Calor sends you to Darkshire with a letter for Jonathan Carevin. Your hunts against the worgen in Duskwood have earned his trust, and he believes your skill can aid Carevin.

sections.title: A Rare Recommendation
sections.body: You drove the Nightbane pack from Roland's Doom and the shadowed glades, earning Calor's respect. He serves on the dark frontier of the woods and rarely offers praise or formal introductions. Now he gives you a faded scrap of parchment for Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire. Calor believes more fighters like you could help his small company outshine the town's beleaguered Night Watch.

sections.title: Carevin's Vigil
sections.body: Jonathan Carevin works in Darkshire under heavy strain. Worgen, restless undead, demonic forces, and cultists who aid the corruption from within all threaten the town. Wary of outsiders and short on time, Carevin trusts Calor's recommendation. He sees you as a dependable fighter who can help preserve the Light against Duskwood's terrors.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Calor sends you to deliver a faded letter of recommendation to Jonathan Carevin. Your success against the worgen packs across Duskwood has earned his respect.

Jonathan Carevin lives in Darkshire and coordinates the town's defense against supernatural threats. Wary of strangers, he works with trusted allies such as Calor against undead, demons, and those who aid them.

faq.q: Why is Calor so dismissive of the Night Watch?
faq.answer: Calor believes the Night Watch is struggling to meet Duskwood's many dangers. He thinks a few capable fighters can do more than the town's small company.

faq.q: What threats does Carevin warn about upon delivery?
faq.answer: Carevin faces worgen, restless undead, demonic forces, and cultists who help the corruption from within. Threats press in on the town from every side.

faq.q: Does this quest require any combat?
faq.answer: No. You only need to take Calor's letter to Carevin in Darkshire. Your earlier hunts against the Nightbane worgen are already behind you.

faq.q: Where can I find Jonathan Carevin?
faq.answer: Jonathan Carevin is in Darkshire, attending to the town's defense.

angles.text: With the Kingdom of Stormwind unable to spare soldiers for Duskwood's borderlands, independent Alliance adventurers and vigilantes like Carevin are the town's only line of defense.
As a paladin, Carevin welcomes proven allies in the name of the Holy Light and seeks holy champions to face Duskwood's unholy evils.
As a priest, you hear Carevin's parting blessing, “Glory under the Light.” It speaks to the defenders' faith amid Darkshire's unending corruption.
